faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Tap the + button in the Library tab and select a document from your device.
faq.a2: We support PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, and TXT files natively.
faq.a3: Yes. All documents are processed and stored locally on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

legal.termsText: By using this application, you agree that you are solely responsible for the documents you import. We do not provide cloud backup services; therefore, if you delete the app or clear its data, your documents will be lost. This app is provided 'as is' without any warranties.
legal.privacyText: Your privacy is our priority. This application does not collect, transmit, or store any of your personal data or documents on external servers. All file processing, thumbnail generation, and text extraction occurs locally on your device. We do not use analytics or tracking software.
